1. (Currently Amended) An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb), a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant, wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb) is specifically modified to enhance immunogenicity compared to non-modified BVDV-lb. 

3. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, wherein the composition is formulated to improve the efficacy of the immune response.

4. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, a modified, live BHV-1, a modified, live BVDV Type la, a modified, live BVDV Type 2, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, wherein the modified, live viruses are formulated to provide an enhanced immune response when administered together with BVDV-lb.

6. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen that is specific for a pathogen associated with bovine respiratory disease.

8. (Currently Amended) The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated and derived from a pathogen known to affect bovids.

12. (Currently Amended) The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen that targets multiple viral pathogens.
